name: Transactions
description:
A recent-transactions card: a title, All / Income / Spending filter tabs and a list of Transaction rows - composed from Tabs, Thumbnail and Icon.

  Transactions(currency: "USD") do
    account.transactions.recent.each do |transaction|
      Transaction(title: transaction.counterparty, category: transaction.category, date: transaction.booked_on,
        amount: transaction.amount, icon: :building_bank)
    end
  end

A positive amount is income, a negative one spending; the tabs filter the rows in the browser (`blocks--transactions`). `filters: false` drops the tabs. Strings: transactions.locales.yml.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `Transactions(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

Transaction.description:
One Transactions row: an icon tile, the counterparty, its category and date, and the signed amount (income in the success color).

  Transaction(title: "Stripe payout", category: "Income", date: Date.new(2026, 7, 3), amount: 860.40, icon: :brand_stripe)

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: The Appica homepage card. Positive amounts are income; the tabs filter the rows.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Transactions(currency:, filters:, **given(title:), class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    ROWS.each { |row| Transaction(**row) }
  end
end

examples.name: Empty filter
examples.notes: Only spending here - the Income tab shows the empty message.
examples.code:
phlex do
  Transactions(class: "w-100 max-w-full") do
    ROWS.select { |row| row[:amount].negative? }.each { |row| Transaction(**row) }
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      Transactions(class: "w-100 max-w-full") { ROWS.first(4).each { |row| Transaction(**row) } }
    end
  end
end
